concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – Modeling (fulfills FR‑003, FR‑007, SC‑002, SC‑005) – T010 verification
concerns.text: FR‑007 requires a Pearson correlation ≤ 0.8 between predictions of the *interpretable* model (symbolic regression / SHAP‑ranked model) and any deep‑learning baseline. The current verification checks correlation between the MLP (deep‑learning) and the tree‑ensemble (black‑box), not between the symbolic regression output and the MLP. This weakens FR‑007.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – Modeling (fulfills FR‑003, FR‑007, SC‑002, SC‑005) – T010 verification
concerns.text: SC‑002 mandates a paired‑t‑test showing |R²_interpretable − R²_baseline| ≤ 0.05. No test for this statistical comparison is present in any verification step.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 6 – External validation (fulfills FR‑005, FR‑006, FR‑007, SC‑003, SC‑004) – T013 verification
concerns.text: FR‑006 requires the system to *adjust* interpretation for any flagged collinearity (e.g., rewrite narrative to be descriptive rather than causal). The task only logs VIF > 5 but does not include a step that modifies or annotates the interpretation accordingly.
